checkpoints: After an edit with a current document, no store write occurs before 120 ms of quiet.
Multiple edits within one quiet interval produce exactly one write containing the latest text.
After a burst saves, a later burst schedules and completes another save.
Pending document-buffer work survives badge/view retirement and remains associated with its document id.
A synchronous listener or navigation callback during a save cannot corrupt the trailing task's pending/handle state.
Search preview behavior remains unchanged, including its independent 40 ms trailing task and hide cancellation.
forbidden_effects: Do not write every edit directly through Environment.Write.
Do not save intermediate text superseded within the same editing burst.
Do not cancel or flush a document's pending save merely because its Badge is detached, the view closes, or navigation opens another document.
Do not couple document-buffer lifetime to the current Badge.
Do not change Preview query timing, cancellation, output, or public API.
Do not change public method signatures, source identities/text, status payloads, or document payload semantics.
lifecycle_identity: BufferBank owns one reusable Trailing document buffer per document id within a Workspace.
Badge owns the live store subscription for the current view; detaching a Badge stops that subscription but does not retire its document buffer.
A pending save retains the document id captured when its BufferBank entry was created, so later navigation does not redirect the write to another document.
Trailing.Flush clears its handle and pending state before invoking save work, allowing synchronous callbacks and later bursts to operate on a clean task state.

obligations.text: Workspace.Edit must enqueue the latest text into the current document's existing Trailing buffer instead of writing immediately.
Each document edit burst must write only its latest text after a 120 ms quiet interval; a new edit before expiry must cancel and replace the prior scheduled callback.
After a flush, the trailing task must be reusable so subsequent edit bursts also save.
Document buffers must remain owned by BufferBank independently of the current Badge/view lifecycle, including synchronous navigation during save callbacks.
Existing editor behavior and public interfaces outside edit coalescing must be preserved.
The adjacent search Preview must remain outside the change.

ordering_barriers: On each Push, cancel any existing scheduled handle before scheduling the new 120 ms callback.
The latest pending text must be installed for the replacement callback, so a superseded callback cannot write intermediate text.
On Flush, cancel/retire the active handle and clear pending state before invoking Environment.Write; save work can synchronously trigger listeners and navigation.
Badge retirement must detach the live subscription without canceling, flushing, or reassigning the BufferBank entry.
A completed flush separates bursts: edits arriving afterward establish new pending state and a new quiet interval.
preservation: Workspace open, close, dispose, document output, and generation behavior remain as publicly exposed.
Opening a document continues to emit its id and current store text.
Badge status output continues to follow synchronous store events for its document while subscribed.
Store read/write/subscribe ordering and original event payload semantics remain unchanged.
Edits with no current view remain no-ops.
Separate document ids retain separate pending trailing tasks.
Preview continues to use its own 40 ms quiet interval, with Hide canceling pending preview work.
scope: Business behavior in src/workflow.go for Workspace.Edit and its use of the existing per-document BufferBank/Trailing utility.
Document edit coalescing only: a 120 ms trailing quiet interval and latest-text save.
No changes to tests, configuration, dependencies, public interfaces, or search preview behavior.

func(b *BufferBank)get(env Environment,id string)*Trailing{if b.entries==nil{b.entries=map[string]*Trailing{}};if b.entries[id]==nil{b.entries[id]=NewTrailing(env,120,func(text string){env.Write(id,text)})};return b.entries[id]}
func(w *Workspace)Edit(text string){view:=w.current;if view!=nil{w.env.Write(view.id,text)}}
func NewPreview(env Environment)*Preview{return &Preview{NewTrailing(env,40,func(query string){env.Output("preview",Value{"query":query})})}}
